summary: Returns up to N most likely alternative tokens with log probabilities at each output position.
combines: Supported on: not documented per-model; commonly unsupported on reasoning models alongside temperature/top_p
Requires `include: ["message.output_text.logprobs"]` to get the logprobs back in the response payload.
Fewer than requested tokens may be returned.
Inflates response size noticeably on long outputs.
